title: SIMPLY THE BEST
body:
It is the only free app that provides sufficient functions without having to do pro. The simple interface makes it my number one go to app. I paid for forest and haven’t used it as much as this free one!

I downloaded this app for a long time but never used it until my master professor recommended us to use it. 

I love the idea that you can customise the time to suit your study needs! After few session you also get a long break. This app makes me sometimes wanted to work for longer than 25 mins. 

Lastly, it works even when you locked your phone or go on other apps during the break. 
Since it is free I will give it a 5 stars.
